name: The Road
notes: The wanderer again, the same man blade for blade: this recipe differs from the_road.json in its sword layer and nothing else, which a test holds. He is drawn from this sheet while this sword is the one he wears, and the sword is in the swing alone, so he still walks the village unarmed. The longsword is what the Keeper was guarding: drawn on 192px frames, cropping to 162 by 85 - the widest swing this game ships, and what the arena floor is measured against.
